title: Commercial Interview Pilot 0.2.0 Draft Schemas
description: 2026-09-09 Draft，FEAT-INTERVIEW-002。六项产品方向已接受；技术细则待审。仅MID、SIMULATION、MANUAL_CONFIRM；总分禁止。权限、时钟、归属、跨字段仍由领域校验。 Pilot constraints are draft: server validates ownership, referenced versions, timing sums and state transitions beyond JSON Schema.

followUpBudget.description: Whole-plan cap; per-primary-question remainingFollowUps is capped separately at 2.

questionText.description: Null in user snapshots before first presentation, or before question generation. Domain context retains the committed question; active presented questions must have text.

remainingFollowUps.description: Remaining follow-ups for the current primary question; never reset by creating a follow-up turn.
